title: BaseSetupRequest
description: Core asks the engine which measured changes make a base setup (POST /base-setup).

items.description: The changeable items of the baseline setup, with their values.

channel.description: The channel experiments are judged on.

rope.description: Band of practical equivalence of that channel.

guardrails.description: Channels that must not get worse; a change measured worse on one is left out.

SensitivityEffect.title: SensitivityEffect
SensitivityEffect.description: What moving one setup item by some clicks does to one channel on this car: a pooled measurement, or a prior transferred from another car and flagged as one.

parameter.description: Item id in the game's setup.

clicks.description: Clicks moved; negative lowers the raw value. Never 0.

estimate.description: Variant minus baseline, in the channel's unit, per corner pass.

nonlinear.description: True when the item's other measured clicks show the response is not a straight line.

note.description: Why it is flagged non-linear, or how a prior was derived; empty otherwise.

is_prior.description: True when this was not measured on this car.

prior_source.description: Name of the car a prior was transferred from; empty for a measurement.

experiment_ids.description: The experiments the measurement is pooled from; empty for a prior.

BaseSetupItem.title: BaseSetupItem
BaseSetupItem.description: One changeable item of the baseline setup.

name.description: Item id in the game's setup.

label.description: Name shown in the game's setup screen.

value.description: Raw value on the baseline setup.

paired.description: True when another item of the car does the same job (one per wheel or side): such an item is never changed alone.

GuardrailSpec.title: GuardrailSpec
GuardrailSpec.description: A channel that must not get worse by more than a tolerance.

tolerance.description: Allowed change in the bad direction, in the channel's unit.
